tools.name: platform_overview
tools.description: Return AI Chili (AIChili) platform capabilities, non-expiring credit pack prices, 5 model IDs, OpenAPI URL, and OnlyChili 80% creator streaming terms.

tools.name: list_video_models
tools.description: Fetch the live AI Chili model registry (/v1/registry) with supported modes, durations, resolutions, aspect ratios, and credit rules.

tools.name: estimate_video_cost
tools.description: Calculate exact PAYG credits (including avatar-talk talk vs photo +10 base-clip credits), lowest-cost non-expiring credit pack combination, and optional OnlyChili 80% creator net revenue.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Check spendable non-expiring credits on an AI Chili account using a chili_sk_* API key.

tools.name: plan_video_generation
tools.description: Dry-run validate generation parameters and return exact total_credits at $0 charge via POST /v1/generations/plan.

tools.name: create_video_generation
tools.description: Submit a live AI video generation job via POST /v1/generations (always run plan_video_generation first).

tools.name: get_video_generation
tools.description: Poll status, credits_cost, and output_asset for a generation job UUID.
